sources.entry: opensearch-py - The official low-level Python client for OpenSearch.

summary.one_liner: opensearch-py is the official low-level Python client for the OpenSearch search and analytics engine, a community fork of elasticsearch-py.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes opensearch-py as an open source fork of elasticsearch-py under the Apache v2.0 License. It is the official low-level Python client for OpenSearch. The README points to a User Guide for getting started and says the repository includes working samples and benchmarks. It links to an API Doc and a compatibility page, but the README itself does not list specific API methods or features. Project resources, code of conduct, and copyright sections are present but contain only links and policy text.
use_cases: connect a Python app to an OpenSearch cluster
index and query documents from Python
migrate Python code from elasticsearch-py to OpenSearch
notable: Official low-level Python client for OpenSearch
Community fork of elasticsearch-py, so existing elasticsearch-py code patterns carry over
Repository includes working samples and benchmarks
caveats: The README does not include install or setup commands; see the linked User Guide
Compatibility with specific OpenSearch versions is covered on a separate page not included in the README
